While that is true, there is an equivalent word to race in modern biological lingo: subspecies. Subspecies and race mean the same thing, and the only reason why race isn't used anymore is because of political correctness. Also there is no clear definition of what exactly constitutes a subspecies, so the classification is more or less arbitrary. Which is why wildcats for example are divided into 22 different regional subspecies, but humans are not. It reflects more the political zeitgeist than scientific facts.
